name: EncounterTypeCodeDeprecatingAtTheRequestOfAMASeeNote
title: EncounterTypeCode (Deprecating at the request of AMA See note)
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
description:
This intensional value set should not be used. VSAC's intensional logic (e.g., LeafOf or DescendantsOf operators) produces unreliable results for CPT. It returns a mix of valid billing codes, non-billable concept IDs, and header codes. In some cases, it returns only the ConceptID for a billable service, omitting the CPT code required for billing.

The new value set (https://vsac.nlm.nih.gov/valueset/2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1267.23/definition) will be extensional, using valid CPT codes extracted from the VSAC export with header and ConceptIDs removed. While the new set is intended to support encounter type classification, the initial version may include some codes not appropriate for that context.
purpose:
(Clinical Focus: Concepts that represent an interaction between a patient and clinician. Interactions may include in-person encounters, telephone conversations, and email exchanges.),(Data Element Scope: Indicator of an encounter),(Inclusion Criteria: CPT codes found in the following CPT sections:
99201-99499 E/M
99500-99600 home health (mainly nonphysician, such as newborn care in home)
99605-99607 medication management
98966-98968 non physician telephone services),(Exclusion Criteria: Only codes as defined in the inclusion criteria)
